notes: Six old kinds became four. 'Peg bag' (k96) merged into 'Clothes pegs' as an accessory type; 'Wash copper' (k99) merged with 'Washboard' (k98) into one hand-wash tools kind with period types (dolly/posser, mangle/wringer added as types per brief). The 'Other clothes airers' catch-all type was dissolved into named form types (folding, wall-mounted, over-bath, ceiling pulley, rotary, line and prop); heated and rotary kept as types. Clothes airer keeps its empty old source as instructed. Minky peg models retained (only two, market-covering); no models or brands added since no research was permitted on this shelf. Dropped the wash-copper retail source in favour of the washboard source for the merged kind.
